basic_details.short_information: The Networking & Communication Research Lab (NCRL) is hiring one Senior Research Fellow (SRF) for work on 5G/6G networks, Linux-based networking software and network security. Applicants need an M.Tech/M.E/M.S in a listed or related discipline, or a B.Tech/B.E in those disciplines with a minimum of 2 years of relevant experience. Pay is as per norms of the institute. Applications go through the designated Google Form with a detailed resume and contact details, latest by 25 December 2026.

content_sections.heading: About NCRL
content_sections.text: The Networking & Communication Research Lab (NCRL) is the research lab named in the notice. The post is a research position in experimental 5G/6G networks, communication protocols and cybersecurity. The notice does not print the lab's address or parent institute.

content_sections.heading: Vacancy Details
content_sections.text: The notice announces 1 position, designated NCRL – Senior Research Fellow (SRF). No category-wise break-up is given.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Linux System Programming: proficiency in C/C++, Python and Shell scripting; socket programming, multithreading, inter-process communication and system-level debugging. Open-Source 5G Platforms: hands-on experience with OpenAirInterface (OAI), srsRAN or similar platforms, including installation, configuration, integration and troubleshooting. 5G/6G Networking and Architecture: understanding of 5G NR, RAN, 5G Core (5GC), network slicing, emerging 6G technologies and 3GPP architecture. Networking and Communication Protocols: strong understanding of TCP/IP, UDP, SCTP, GTP-U, routing and switching; familiarity with RRC, NAS, NGAP and PDCP. Networking Tools and Performance Analysis: experience with Wireshark, tcpdump, iPerf and Linux networking utilities for packet analysis, troubleshooting and performance evaluation. Network Security and Cybersecurity: knowledge of secure communication protocols, authentication, encryption, firewalls, intrusion detection and attack mitigation. Vulnerability Analysis and Security Testing: experience in vulnerability assessment, protocol security analysis, threat modelling and authorized penetration testing using tools such as Nmap and OpenVAS. Scripting and Automation: proficiency in Python, Shell scripting and automation for network deployment, monitoring, testing and experimental data collection. Experience with SDR platforms such as USRP and GNU Radio. Knowledge of O-RAN, SDN and NFV. Familiarity with Open5GS, Docker, Kubernetes and cloud-native network deployment. Exposure to AI/ML-based network security, anomaly detection and intelligent network management. Ability to design experiments, analyse results, document findings and contribute to research publications.

rows.qualification_required: Computer Science, Electronics and Communication Engineering, Electrical and Electronics Engineering, Telecommunications Engineering or a related discipline, with a good academic record.
In any of the above or related disciplines, with a minimum of 2 years of relevant experience in networking, wireless communication, Linux-based software development or cybersecurity.

content_sections.heading: NCRL – Senior Research Fellow (SRF) Job Description
content_sections.text: 5G/6G Network Infrastructure Development: design, implementation and configuration of experimental 5G and emerging 6G networks using OpenAirInterface (OAI) and srsRAN, integrating radio access networks (RAN), core networks and user equipment. Linux System-Based Programming: development of Linux-based networking applications, system-level software and tools for network configuration, monitoring, performance optimization and automation. Networking and Communication Protocols: implementation, integration and evaluation of next-generation wireless communication protocols, including traffic monitoring and Quality of Service (QoS) assessment. Network Security and Cybersecurity: investigation of security challenges in 5G/6G networks through vulnerability analysis, threat modelling, security testing, attack detection and development of security mechanisms. Experimental Testbeds and Demonstrations: establishment and integration of communication and cybersecurity testbeds using software-defined radios (SDRs), open-source networking platforms, virtualized network functions and security tools.
